name: Foundry Design Control
longDescription: Foundry turns a running product into a local design workbench for coding agents. Select and manipulate rendered elements, inspect project-native tokens and components, review a source-mapped change set, apply only approved changes, and verify the rebuilt result. Foundry stores preview state and apply history locally; your coding-agent provider has its own data policies. The interface and documentation are currently in English.
commerceDescription: Foundry does not offer payments, purchases or subscriptions through the plugin.
starterPrompts: Verify the latest Foundry design session.
releaseNotes: Initial public-directory submission of Foundry's local-first visual design workflow for Codex and ChatGPT.
